Game Overview

Weapon Run Battle puts players into a casual experience centered on dash, leap, and blast through thrilling levels in Weapon Run Battle. Collect cash to upgrade your arsenal and strategically choose weapons to defeat challenging enemies. Adrenaline-pumping parkour meets dynamic shooting action, offering endless opportunities to refine tactics and achieve ultimate triumph. Prepare for an exhilarating, money-fueled adventure!
